_comment: BI-35 golden file for the budget arithmetic.
Every expected value here was worked out by hand from the rules, not captured from a run.
That is the point: a golden file generated from the implementation pins whatever the code
does today, bug included. These pin what the code is supposed to do, so a change to the
arithmetic has to be argued for rather than re-recorded.
Amounts and percentages are compared as strings because the scale is part of the contract:
a utilisation of 51.7 and one of 51.70 are the same number and a different answer.
